The Office of International Affairs is hosting the International Talent Retention and Employment Lecture Series.

For this session, we are honored to invite Chi-hwan Lin, Technical Manager of Certification & Scheme Management at TÜV Rheinland Taiwan Ltd., to share insights on "The Role of Accreditation and Certification in Carbon Management."

All interested students are welcome to join!

Date: 2025-04-15
Time: 14 pm- 17 pm
Location:  Administration Building, Meeting Room 301
2 Hours of Interdisciplinary Credits
